authority.effective_when: ADR 0001 and this manifest are merged to main

repositories.notes: Thin ecosystem coordination, topology, compatibility and release authority; no product runtime source.
Current coordinate is recorded from the accepted pre-META topology authority; this bootstrap does not inspect or mutate the Game repository.
Portal, Identity, Accounts, GameAuth, Gateway and other Platform-owned web/application control-plane modules remain together.
Repository existence is proven. Selective ownership separation/history extraction, publication and deployment are independently gated and are not implied complete.

contract_rule: Provider-owned schemas and runtime implementation remain canonical in provider repositories; META records coordinates, immutable identities and compatible combinations without normative duplication.
